subject: NovusHealth exec supper — VIP arrival, transport plan & kitchen access
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Jenkins <samantha.jenkins@novushealth.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NovusHealth exec supper — VIP arrival, transport plan & kitchen access

Samantha —

Thanks again for hosting the NovusHealth executive workshop next week. Per our sync, attaching two initial artifacts: a short menu options packet and the preliminary guest spreadsheet so we can lock dietary restrictions. High-level plan below; please confirm any changes by EOD Friday so we can finalize logistics.

High-level plan (proposed)
- Date / time: Thu, 29 Oct — 7:00PM arrival / 7:30PM service
- Venue: The Bayside Kitchen (private dining room)
- Guest count: 18 (5 execs + 13 guests) — see attached guest_list.csv
- Chef: Samir Rao (private tasting available Wed afternoon)
- Cuisine: 3-course plated with two vegetarian options + kosher-certified dessert (options in novus_menu_options.pdf)
- Transport: shared town cars for execs (2 cars, 4 pax each) + rideshare credits for remaining guests
- Entrances: Private service door + dedicated coat check — need confirmation from venue about a staffed private entrance for VIPs

Immediate asks
1) Can you confirm any additional dietary restrictions beyond the five noted in the spreadsheet?
2) Do we need a wireless lapel mic for toasts (venue to confirm availability)?
3) Approve the transport approach (town cars for execs, rideshare credits for guests) and budget cap of $1,200 for ground ops.

Attachments: novus_menu_options.pdf (menu + wine pairings), guest_list.csv (names, titles, dietary notes)

If you're open, David can coordinate the town car bookings and I'll loop Lucas (venue contact) to confirm private entrance window and staging for chef deliveries.

Thanks — looking forward.

—
Evelyn Hart
Head, Customer Events | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0134
From: Samantha Jenkins <samantha.jenkins@novushealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael Hsu <michael.hsu@novushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovusHealth exec supper — VIP arrival, transport plan & kitchen access

Evelyn —

Thanks — this looks great. Quick answers:
- Dietary: add one severe nut allergy (VP of Product), and one pescatarian. I've updated the guest_list.csv on our side (I attached a copy).
- AV: Yes, we will need a wireless lapel mic and one handheld for a brief toast by our CEO at ~8:15PM. Please ensure a small stage area or cleared space near the head table.
- Private entrance: Prefer the private entrance for our CEO and two board members; please confirm 6:45PM drop-off window so we can schedule security.

On transport — town cars for the execs are perfect. For non-execs, rideshare credits are fine. Please keep the budget under $1,300 total; we can flex within that.

Also, one small ask: can we have a printed place card for each guest with names + titles? If you can confirm final guest titles by Monday we’ll print them on our end; otherwise happy for Redwood to handle printing.

Thanks — looking forward.

Samantha Jenkins
Director, Events | NovusHealth
samantha.jenkins@novushealth.com | 617-555-9842
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Jenkins <samantha.jenkins@novushealth.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Lucas Romero <lucas@baysidekitchen.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 10:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovusHealth exec supper — VIP arrival, transport plan & kitchen access

Samantha —

Perfect — thanks for the quick clarifications. Action items and updates below.

Action items we picked up
- Dietary: Chef Samir will rework the third course to offer a nut-free plated option and a pescatarian main. Lucas — please confirm your kitchen can guarantee nut-free plating for one guest and mark the seat on the floorplan.
- AV/staging: Monica will confirm lapel + handheld mic rental with the AV house and reserve a small podium space near the head table.
- Private entrance: Lucas — can we open the service entrance at 6:30PM and have a staffer meet the car at 6:45PM for the VIP drop? Please also confirm a sheltered route from curb to door (rain contingency).
- Transport: David — please proceed with town car quotes (2 cars) and one backup sedan; keep receipts in shared folder. If you want, use the transport_plan.pdf (attached) as the vendor brief.

Estimated costs (ballpark)
- Catering (food + server fee): $3,200
- Wine pairing (optional): $650
- Town cars + contingency: $850 (within Novus cap)
- AV rental + technician: $275
- Place card printing: $75
- Total (w/ wine): ~$5,050

Next steps
1) Lucas — confirm kitchen nut-free handling and entrance timing by EOD tomorrow (Fri 23 Oct).
2) David — confirm town car vendor & provisional booking by Mon 26 Oct.
3) Samantha — final headcount and titles by Mon 26 Oct for place cards.

Attachments: transport_plan.pdf (vendor brief for town car bookings)

I'll add the calendar invite for 7:00PM and include the Bayside Kitchen address and contact.

—
Evelyn
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Jenkins <samantha.jenkins@novushealth.com>

Subject: Re: NovusHealth exec supper — VIP arrival, transport plan & kitchen access

Flagging quick vendor notes —

On Thu, 22 Oct 2026 at 10:28 AM Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> David — please proceed with town car quotes (2 cars) and one backup sedan; keep receipts in shared folder.

Booked one town car vendor (GoldenGate Limo) for two cars with a backup sedan on hold. Quote attached in the transport_plan.pdf. Pick-up windows: 6:30PM for board members (drop-off at private entrance 6:45PM), 6:50PM for execs.

I also confirmed the venue can stage a rain-covered route from curb to service entrance and the kitchen manager (Lucas) will segregate plating for the nut-free guest. Lucas — please confirm the plating label so servers don’t cross-contact; recommend a colored napkin or plate marker.

I'll finalize invoices Monday and upload to the shared Drive.

-David
